content.title: Euphoria season 3 release schedule: When is episode 3 out in the UK and US?
content.text: Euphoria is stirring up more controversy in its third season, which has left viewers shocked by provocative scenes featuring Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) as she pursues a new business venture.The character is raising money for her upcoming nuptials via OnlyFans and Euphoria isn't leaving much to the imagination in terms of the content she makes for the platform.The new development has triggered further debates online about creator Sam Levinson's stylistic taste, which follow his similarly controversial showbiz drama The Idol.Elsewhere, Rue (Zendaya) currently finds herself working as a drug mule to repay her debt to Laurie (Martha Kelly), who remains a frightening presence in an expanded role from season 2.On the appeal of the character, Kelly told The Hollywood Reporter: "[Levinson] decided to create a mild-mannered sociopath; in real life, those are the scariest people, the disarming, vulnerable, seemingly nice ones who have no conscience."I kind of talk and have the same mannerisms in every role, so he just wrote it to where that's how it would be me just acting the way I do and everything I'm in, honestly."So, when can fans get their next dose of Euphoria? Read on for details on when to expect episode 3, plus the full release schedule so you can make sure you never miss a moment.Euphoria season 3 poster. HBOEuphoria season 3, episode 3 premieres on Sky Atlantic and NOW at 2am on Monday 27 April 2026, coinciding with the US debut so you don't have to worry about falling behind.After a long absence, the latest chapter of the edgy drama premiered in the UK on Monday 13 April on HBO Max, Sky Atlantic and NOW, while in the US, it launched on Sunday 12 April.What is Euphoria season 3's release schedule?Jacob Elordi in Euphoria season 3. HBOThe full release schedule for Euphoria season 3 is as follows, complete with release dates for both the UK and US.Episode 1 - Ándale - UK: Monday 13 April and US: Sunday 12 April (out now)Episode 2 - America My Dream - UK: Monday 20 April and US: Sunday 19 April (out now)Episode 3 - The Ballad of Paladin - UK: Monday 27 April and US: Sunday 26 April Episode 4 - Kitty Likes to Dance - UK: Monday 4 May and US: Sunday 3 May Episode 5 - This Little Piggy - UK: Monday 11 May and US: Sunday 10 May Episode 6 - Stand Still and See - UK: Monday 18 May and US: Sunday 17 May Episode 7 - Rain or Shine - UK: Monday 25 May and US: Sunday 24 May Episode 8 - In God We Trust - UK: Monday 1 June and US: Sunday 31 May How many episodes of Euphoria season 3 are there?There will be eight episodes in the third season of Euphoria. It follows the previous two seasons that were both also comprised of eight episodes.Euphoria season 3 trailerYou can find the trailer for Euphoria season 3 below.Euphoria season 3 is airing weekly on HBO Max, Sky Atlantic and NOW.
